name: Days AGO FatTree48 k48/h16 wall-clock timing on one GB200

00.description: Validate the SM100 build against Scalar, CPU and CUDA on one small fixture, then time the native 5,530-flow 30% load through 1.024 ms of virtual time and check its packet counts.

01.name: Days AGO FatTree48 full Nsight Systems profile
01.description: Profile the full pinned FT48 run through 1.024 ms on one GB200, with CUDA graph nodes, SMs Active, SM Issue and DRAM activity. Compare the complete-state fingerprint and work counters with an unprofiled run of the same binary.

02.name: Days AGO FatTree48 full warp lifetime trace
02.description: Trace every warp of the full FT48 graph replays and direct gathers on one GB200. Check CTA and warp coverage at every launch and match the baseline state fingerprint and work counters.

03.name: Days AGO FatTree48 10-second Nsight Systems compute triage
03.description: Capture the first 10 wall-clock seconds of the single-GB200 k48/h16 30% CUDA graph loop at 10 kHz with gb10x-ct. Stop collection at the first synchronized wave boundary at or after 10 s. Report Compute SOL, SM Issue Active and DRAM read/write bandwidth with graph nodes, encoded attempts and committed rounds. Require a native report at most 64 MiB. Continue through 1.024 ms of virtual time and compare the final fingerprint and work counters with an unprofiled run of the same binary.
